boundary_principles.heading: trivial task 可以轻量处理，但不能越界

architecture: 定义 `execution/index.md`、`architecture-blueprint.md`、`service-slice-map.md`、`git-workflow-*`、`technical-review-contract-*` 等执行 host 材料的最低存在与字段要求。
子 skill 材料闭环层
定义每个人类面 skill 的 `material_effect`、目标材料面、只读边界、写回义务和 fail-closed 条件。
`implement`、`qa`、`release`、`doctor verify-context --strict`、`material audit` 必须消费这些材料状态并在缺失时阻断。
support surface 不直接写 canonical truth
toolkit surface 一旦改变项目事实，必须写入 canonical metadata / execution transaction path
execution-bound feature 不允许从默认 branch / service / worktree 假设进入 implement
side dossier 不能替代 canonical execution host
decision_priority: Frozen truth 高于 support finding。
显式冻结事实高于 default seed。
Canonical execution host 高于 side dossier。
Open obligation 高于局部 green signal。
Requirement clarity gate 高于 implement convenience。
QA evidence chain 高于单层通过。
Release gate 高于 status board。

tasks.title: FR-001 Beacon 必须恢复 execution host required surface contract
tasks.description: 对 execution-bound feature，Beacon 至少必须能要求和校验： `docs/beacon/<version>/execution/index.md` `docs/beacon/<version>/execution/architecture-blueprint.md` `docs/beacon/<version>/.machine/execution/implementation-delivery-baseline-<feature>.json` `docs/beacon/<version>/.machine/execution/git-workflow-<feature>.json` `docs/beacon/<version>/.machine/execution/technical-review-contract-<feature>.json`

tasks.title: FR-002 Beacon 必须阻断缺失或漂移的 architecture blueprint projection
tasks.description: 如果 `architecture-blueprint.md` 缺失、managed projection 缺失、或 projection drift，`implement` 必须 fail closed。

tasks.title: FR-003 Beacon 必须冻结 branch / service / worktree explicit-fact gate
tasks.description: 下列字段不能仅依赖默认 seed 解锁 implement： `target_branch` `service_directories` `writable_services` `direct_delivery_services` `use_git_worktree` `worktree_root` `worktree_path` per-service branch mapping

tasks.title: FR-004 Beacon 必须识别 weak fact source
tasks.description: 以下来源不得单独解锁 implement： `source=version_default` `source=project_config_seed` blank `approved_by` blank `reviewed_at` missing managed projection block

tasks.title: FR-005 Beacon 必须冻结 per-subskill material effect registry
tasks.description: 每个人类面子 skill 必须声明： `surface` `feature` `version` `material_effect` `target_artifacts` `truth_bindings` `accepted_route` `open_obligations` `fail_closed_gate`

tasks.title: FR-006 Beacon 必须让 support finding 进入采纳契约
tasks.description: 当 support finding 被接受时，必须转成以下之一： `change` update `prd` update `user-story` update `test-case` update `prototype` update `execution-host` update `technical-review-contract` update `git-workflow` update `qa-evidence` update `release-blocker` update `artifact_update_obligation`

tasks.title: FR-007 Beacon 必须让 branch governance 更新走 canonical writeback
tasks.description: 当 `beacon-toolkit-branch-governance` 被用于更新交付服务、目标分支或 worktree 时，必须写回或要求： `execution/git-workflow-<feature>.md` `.machine/execution/git-workflow-<feature>.json` `execution/technical-review-contract-<feature>.md` `.machine/execution/technical-review-contract-<feature>.json` `execution/architecture-blueprint.md` `execution/service-slice-map.md` canonical metadata contract

tasks.title: FR-008 Beacon 必须阻断 open artifact update obligations
tasks.description: 当 `artifact_update_obligations` 中存在 blocking open items 时： review quality 必须阻断 QA 必须阻断 release 必须阻断 implement 是否允许继续必须由 obligation 类型显式决定

tasks.title: FR-009 Beacon 必须提供 no silent pass diagnostics
tasks.description: 当 gate 阻断时，输出必须说明： 缺哪个 material surface 哪个字段是 default-seeded 哪个 support finding 未采纳 哪个 obligation 仍 open 推荐回到哪个 Beacon surface 修复

tasks.title: FR-010 Beacon 必须保持 support surface 边界
tasks.description: 即便 support finding 被采纳，support surface 仍不得： 直接写 canonical truth 直接给 release verdict 直接绕过 `change -> prd -> user-story -> test-case -> requirement_clarity -> freeze` ## 6. 冻结交付物 `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/research/beacon-v1.4.8-execution-material-rigor-and-version-governance-analysis.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/research/beacon-v1.4.8-human-subskill-material-closure-and-gate-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/research/beacon-v1.4.8-material-gate-and-human-subskill-atomic-writeback-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/source-architecture/index.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/change/beacon-v1.4.8-material-gate-and-human-subskill-atomic-writeback-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/prd/beacon-v1.4.8-material-gate-and-human-subskill-atomic-writeback-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/user-story/beacon-v1.4.8-material-gate-and-human-subskill-atomic-writeback-contract.md` `docs/beacon/v1.4.8/qa/test-cases/beacon-v1.4.8-material-gate-and-human-subskill-atomic-writeback-contract.md` ## 7. 风险与缓解 | 风险 | 影响 | 缓解 | | --- | --- | --- | | runtime 代码未实现但文档已存在 | 后续误以为 release-ready | release checklist 明确保持 `blocked_pending_implementation_and_qa` | | support finding 被误当成 truth | 冻结材料漂移或绕过 change/refreeze | accepted finding 必须进入 truth update、execution update、evidence update 或 blocking obligation | | 默认 seed 被误当成 approved fact | implement 从错误 branch/service/worktree 开始 | explicit-fact gate 阻断 `version_default`、`project_config_seed` 和未 review 字段 | | side dossier 替代 canonical execution host | 人类和 agent 找不到稳定事实来源 | execution host surface 必须绑定 `execution/index.md`、`architecture-blueprint.md` 和机器 projection | | 子 skill 只输出建议不写回材料 | gate 无法消费 finding | 每次调用必须产出 material effect 和 target artifact | ## 8. 验收标准 AC-001 Beacon defines a required execution host surface contract for execution-bound features, including `execution/index.md`, `execution/architecture-blueprint.md`, delivery baseline, git workflow, and technical review contract. AC-002 Beacon blocks `implement` when architecture blueprint projection is missing, drifted, or not bound to the canonical execution host. AC-003 Beacon treats branch / service / worktree facts as explicit frozen facts, not as acceptable silent defaults. AC-004 Beacon marks `source=version_default`, `source=project_config_seed`, blank `approved_by`, blank `reviewed_at`, or missing managed projection as weak fact sources that cannot unlock implementation by themselves. AC-005 Beacon provides a per-subskill material effect registry covering host, truth, execution, gate, support, toolkit, compatibility, and project-local skills. AC-006 Beacon requires every human-facing subskill invocation to resolve to `writeback_completed`, `writeback_required`, `obligation_opened`, `truth_reopen_required`, `execution_host_update_required`, `evidence_update_required`, or `read_only_route_only`. AC-007 Beacon converts accepted support findings into explicit material updates, release blockers, or `artifact_update_obligations`. AC-008 Beacon keeps support surfaces advisory unless their findings are adopted through `change`, truth surfaces, execution host updates, evidence updates, or obligations. AC-009 Beacon makes `beacon-toolkit-branch-governance` write delivery service, branch, and worktree updates through canonical git workflow, technical review contract, execution host, service slice, and metadata surfaces. AC-010 Beacon blocks QA and release while blocking artifact update obligations remain open. AC-011 Beacon emits diagnostics that name the missing material, default-seeded field, unadopted support finding, open obligation, and recommended repair surface. AC-012 Beacon preserves the main lifecycle boundary and does not turn support or toolkit skills into truth sources, gate sources, or new lifecycle stages.

planner.purpose: Compile execution-ready task scope from the frozen revision baseline.

implementation-architect.purpose: Translate frozen requirement truth into implementation-safe module boundaries and service ownership guidance.

implementer.purpose: Write code inside the frozen scope and the implementation architecture note.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.

implementation_preflight: Before implementation, verify the target service belongs to: .
Before implementation, verify the current branch is beacon/v1.4.8.
If a branch switch is needed and the worktree is dirty, stop and clean or stash first.
